children: Nestle gave a helpful update for the third quarter that will likely build credibility, according to Jefferies analyst David Hayes. He says the company delivered stronger real internal growth--a measure of volume of products sold--than analysts anticipated. The consumer goods giant on Thursday reported sales above company-compiled estimates. Shares are up 1.13%. (aimee.look@wsj.com)
